stem_book: A spherical body of mass 100 g is dropped from a height of 10 m from the ground. After hitting the ground, the body rebounds to a height of 5 m. The impulse of force imparted by the ground to the body is given by: (given g = 9.8 m s⁻²) (a) 4.32 kg m s⁻¹ (b) 43.2 kg m s⁻¹ (c) 23.9 kg m s⁻¹ (d) 2.39 kg m s⁻¹
